name: CloudflareSSL
description: A small Docker container that generates Let's Encrypt certificates for Unraid using the Cloudflare API allowing to avoid "this page is not secure" warnings when connecting to Unraid locally.

paths.name: Unraid SSL Bundle
paths.description: Path to the Unraid SSL bundle file. This should be stored in /boot/config/ssl/certs/HOSTNAME_unraid_bundle.pem

variables.name: Cloudflare API Token
variables.description: Token to authenticate against the Cloudflare API endpoint.

variables.name: Email
variables.description: Email address for Let's Encrypt notifications.

variables.name: Domains
variables.description: Comma-separated list of domains for which to obtain the certificate.

variables.name: Key Type
variables.description: Type of private key to generate (e.g. ecdsa, rsa).

variables.name: Renewal Interval
variables.description: Interval between certificate renewal checks. Set to 0 to disable renewals and only run once.
